description: A single click on button 2 of the den's SNZB-01M multi button (owner, 2026-11-06) switches the sideboard lamp's plug (switch.den_plug_sideboard_lamp_switch) off, waits 5 seconds, and switches it back on. A click during those 5 seconds is ignored. Its own automations follow the plug's power: the den tall lamp goes off when the draw drops to 0 W and on again when it is back at 1 W or more (den_tall_lamp_off_with_sideboard_lamp and den_tall_lamp_on_with_sideboard_lamp), so the tall lamp goes off when the draw drops, and stays off: the sideboard lamp comes back off after a power cut and the plug's 5 W reading as it switches on is ignored by den_tall_lamp_on_with_sideboard_lamp for 10 seconds. If HA restarts during the 5 seconds the plug stays off. The button is the zha_event's endpoint_id and the click its command (HOME-ASSISTANT.md gotcha 33). Button 1 is den_multibutton_tall_lamp. Source: tools/ha/automations in the HomeAssistant repo.
